messages:
Marta: flagging a visual regression in the console charts — when there are >8 series the legend wraps into the tooltip area and outlier markers overlap the names. Screenshot: https://redwood.example/snap/legend-clash.png
Aj: can you paste the chart config? is this small-multiples or one dense timeseries?
Marta: single panel. legend is set to compact + wrap, units mixed (req/s, ms, %). markers are high-contrast red for spikes.
Ryan: quick read: two probs — legend density (too many items) and visual weight of outlier markers pulling attention. also unit labels making lines hard to scan.
Tara: idea: "signal hierarchy" — show top 4 series by recent amplitude, collapse remainder into a single "Other (n)" entry that expands. also add a subtle unit grouping (e.g., group ms together) to reduce cognitive load.
Aj: collapsing sounds good. accessibility concern: ensure collapsed group can be keyboard-expanded and read by screen readers.
Marta: draft microcopy for collapsed state: "Other (8) — expand to see low-volume series" — too verbose?
Ryan: fine. implementation notes: aria-expanded on the collapse button; role=listbox for legend. tentative css:```css
.legend-collapsed { max-height: 72px; overflow: hidden; }
.legend-item--highlight { outline: 2px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06); }
```
Tara: accessibility nit: add `aria-label=\"Legend: showing 4 of 12 series\"` and expose expand via keyboard (tab -> press Enter/Space). Also ensure SR reads the group name + count.
Marta: another interaction: smoothing toggle affects which series are ranked as "top" — propose we show a tiny badge in the legend title: "Ranking uses current smoothing" (tooltip).
Aj: UX question: should we surface an explicit spike badge in legend entries (e.g., :zap: ) when a series has a recent outlier?
Ryan: we can. backend can compute a boolean spike flag in the timeseries payload; cheap to compute at query time. default off, opt-in in viz config.
Marta: copy tweak for the spike control hover: change "Show raw spikes" -> "Show spike markers (high-sensitivity)" — clearer?
Tara: +1. keyboard shortcuts: suggest `L` to focus legend and `E` to expand/collapse when focused. note for SRE: nothing intrusive.
Aj: action items: Ryan -> prototype aria attributes + spike flag in API; Tara -> draft microcopy and keyboard flow; Marta -> mock collapsed/expanded visuals including unit-grouping; I'll coordinate sync next Tue morning.
Marta: thanks all :tada:
chartbot: New draft uploaded: https://redwood.example/design/legend-proto-v1.png
